newsitem.title: POLAND: HALF OF SOKOLOW NEW ISSUE TO GO RIGHTS.
newsitem.headline: HALF OF SOKOLOW NEW ISSUE TO GO RIGHTS.

text.p: Polish meat producer Sokolow SA's planned issue of 5.5 million shares will go in two tranches, one open and one rights, of 2.75 million shares each, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
Sokolow had previously planned for all the shares to go ex-rights.

The firm said the rights tranche would go on a one-for-10 basis for those holding shares on August 1, 1997 and that the open tranche would be geared toward banks, insurers and investment funds. Sokolow has 27.5 million shares outstanding.
